# rp-empty-state



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

A generic empty-state placeholder (no favorites yet, no search results, etc.).
Place a call-to-action button/link in the default slot.

## Properties

| Property               | Attribute | Description                                   | Type     | Default     |
| ---------------------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `heading` _(required)_ | `heading` | Heading text.                                 | `string` | `undefined` |
| `icon`                 | `icon`    | Emoji or short glyph shown above the heading. | `string` | `'🍽️'`     |
| `message`              | `message` | Supporting message.                           | `string` | `undefined` |
